MERGE ORDER WARNING: gcrip/godot.py:8980 merges data/ww_enemies_*.json with sorted() + dict.update(), i.e. WHOLE-ENTRY replacement in filename order. 'ww_enemies_minibosses.json' sorts BEFORE 'ww_enemies_other.json', so the older null-heavy wiz_r / p_hat / Oq entries in ww_enemies_other.json still win. Rename one of the two files (e.g. ww_enemies_other.json -> ww_enemies_stubs.json, or this one -> ww_enemies_z_minibosses.json) for the entries below to take effect. Tn (Darknut) and Stal (Stalfos) are deliberately NOT in this file: ww_enemies_melee.json already carries complete, verified entries for both and a duplicate here would replace them wholesale.

gmos.notes:
MOST NUMBERS ARE GENUINELY UNRECOVERABLE. d_a_gm.cpp is a complete /* Nonmatching */ stub (24 of 26 functions), gm_class has no named fields, and the REL has no HIO or parameter table symbol - so hp, radius, height, notice, lose, walk, run, gravity, terminal, turn_s16, attack_range, hit_frame and knockback are null on purpose, not by omission. What IS real: the four collision templates' AT types and Atp values, the 20 BCK names, and their frame lengths measured from the ripped Gm.arc gltf. attack_frames 20 = the winged atack01 clip; the wingless/ground variant's attacks are g_atack01 18f, g_atack02 7f, g_atack03 14f, g_hammer 23f, g_machingun 16f. flinch_frames 23 = g_damage. damage 2 = the wing spike (Atp 2); the mouth 'weapon' sphere is only Atp 1, so a wingless Mothula should deal 1.
BEHAVIOUR THE MELEE/FLYING SHAPE CANNOT EXPRESS: Mothula is two-phase and the phase is chosen by params bits 16-23 - 0x02 = winged (flies, clings to walls and ceilings via action_kabehari, hovers with fuwafuwa_set, charges with action_totugeki), 0x01 = wingless (walks on the ground, g_walk/g_wait/g_atack*). Cutting the wings (wing_cut_stat / action_hane_rakka, boomerang or sword) turns a winged one into a wingless one mid-fight and drops the separate hanesl/haneul wing models as a falling actor. It continuously spawns Morths (ks_set_rtn -> d_a_ks 'kuro_s'), up to 10 wingless / 20 winged, tracked in m31E; those Morths give up the moment Mothula's health hits 0. action_uchiwa_dousa flaps a wind cylinder (AT_TYPE_WIND, no damage) that shoves Link. The Forbidden Woods miniboss placement in kinMB uses param 0x19000000 - its type byte is 0x00, the same class d_a_ks treats as boss-linked. boss:true is set because the story graph watches this death.
Sizing hint only (NOT the collider): the ripped gm.gltf mesh spans x +/-298.7 (wings spread), y -224.5..+241.8, z -35.4..+125.5. Do not copy those into radius/height - the same measurement on control actors mispredicts badly (Tn mesh half-width 171 vs real collider r90, Am2 75 vs r35).

wiz_r.notes:
IMPROVES ON ww_enemies_other.json but is blocked by merge order (see _README). New here: attack_frames 54 and flinch_frames 24 measured from the ripped Wz.arc animations, and radius changed from the misleading 15.0 placeholder to null so the Godot fallback (40) is used instead of a 15-unit collider.
STILL UNRECOVERABLE: hp, height, notice/lose, teleport cadence, fireball speed/range/cooldown, turn rate, knockback. d_a_wz.cpp is a total stub and wz_class exposes no numeric fields. The wwrando 'two pots to kill' note hints at low HP but a pot's Atp is not established here, so hp stays null.
BEHAVIOUR THE MELEE/FLYING SHAPE CANNOT EXPRESS: a Wizzrobe has no Co collider at all (d_a_wz.cpp:153) - Link walks through it. It cycles vanish -> reappear elsewhere (syutugen1, 30f) -> charge (tame1 45f / tame2 60f) -> cast (attack1 54f) -> vanish, optionally hopping along a path (mPathIndex). The fireball is a separate hittable object (ball Tg set) that steers toward Link (next_tama_move) and can be destroyed or reflected. The miniboss variant (mIsMiniBoss, the Wind Temple arena) opens a summon door (summon_door_draw / action_summon_dousa / summon_call_sub) and calls in waves of enemies from enemy_name_dt/enemy_arg_dt/birth_dt. kizetu1 (74f) is a stun state and press1-3 / airdown1 / batabata1 are crush and knocked-out-of-the-air reactions.

Oq.notes:
IMPROVES ON ww_enemies_other.json but is blocked by merge order (see _README). New here: attack_frames 26 (aattack2_fuku, the spit) and flinch_frames 64 (ship_hit) measured from the ripped Oq.arc animations, and radius changed from the misleading 15.0 placeholder to null.

CAVEAT ON flinch_frames: ship_hit (64f) is the only damage-shaped clip in the archive and is really the reaction to being rammed by the boat, so 64 frames of flinch may be far too long for a sword hit - treat it as an upper bound.
BEHAVIOUR THE MELEE SHAPE CANNOT EXPRESS: an Octorok is a submerging turret, not a walker. action_wakidasi surfaces it (start 18f), action_dousa idles/aims (umi_new_wait or nom_wait, 30f loops), action_tama_shoot spits a rock (aattack2_fuku 26f) that Link can slash or shield back at it - the rock carries both an At (Atp 1) and a Tg sphere. moguru_check dives it back under (moguru 27f) when threatened, and while submerged it should be untargetable. action_kougeki is the water-jet ram (jet_attack 15f / jet_loop 30f, Atp 2) used by the saltwater Oqw against the King of Red Lions. It is immune to AT_TYPE_WIND, so the Deku Leaf does nothing. ikaku (30f) is a threat/rear-up pose; dead1-3 (26/12/24f) form the death chain.

p_hat.notes:
IMPROVES ON ww_enemies_other.json but is blocked by merge order (see _README). New here: flinch_frames 24 (bdamage) measured from the ripped Ph.arc animations, the exact Tg mask on the propeller, and radius changed from the misleading 15.0 placeholder to null. attack_frames stays null because the attack clip BJAWS is the single BCK the ripper did not export, so its length is unmeasured.
STILL UNRECOVERABLE: hp, height, notice/lose, hover height, fly speed, spin rate, knockback. Two named 24-byte search_data blocks exist in the REL but the binary is absent.
BEHAVIOUR THE MELEE/FLYING SHAPE CANNOT EXPRESS: a Peahat is TWO models and two morfs - php (propeller, 'p' clips) on top of phb (body, 'b' clips) - and the propeller is the whole fight. It hovers with fuwafuwa_set while puropera_kaiten spins the blades; the spinning blade cylinder is AT_TYPE_SPIKE Atp 1 and is what hurts Link, while the body deals nothing. The propeller's Tg accepts ONLY sword and wind (d_a_ph.cpp:209), so a Deku Leaf gust or a sword swing severs it (ph_bunri_move) - arrows, bombs and the boomerang cannot. Once severed the body drops (ph_fujyou_move / ph_hane_move, bchakuchi 38f landing) and is finished off on the ground; ph_wind_move and ph_water_move handle being blown about and hitting water. The 'sh' variant (ph_fly_sea_move, search_data_sh) is the Seahat, which patrols the ocean and chases the boat.
